newsitem.title: BELGIUM: International anti-drugs swoop nets 123 people.
newsitem.headline: International anti-drugs swoop nets 123 people.

text.p: A combined operation against drug tourism by Belgian, French and Dutch police resulted in 123 arrests and the seizure of quantities of narcotics, Belgian police said on Saturday.
A total of 2,500 police from all three neigbouring nations were involved in the overnight operation codenamed "No Way Out".

During checks of 22,000 people and 12,000 vehicles they seized four kilogrammes of cannabis, 300 grammes of heroin, more than 600 ecstacy pills, 20 grammes of cocaine, 50 grammes of amphetamines and five firearms.

France, Belgium and the Netherlands have frequently argued over the liberal Dutch policy on soft drugs, and there are frequent spot checks on the motorways across northern Belgium between the Netherlands and France.
